// as: packages/engine/src/clean-probe.ts
// expect: none
// 정상 경로: egress·redaction·model 계약만 쓴다.
import { Egress } from '@sax/net';
import { apply } from '@sax/redaction';
import type { DecideRequest } from '@sax/model';
export const e = new Egress();
export const r = (s: string, req: Omit<DecideRequest, 'input'>): DecideRequest => ({ ...req, input: apply(s, { runId: 'r' }).redacted });
